purpose: Does a Bash allow list exist under --restricted when --tools names Bash? This is the #138 frozen primary launch shape minus the proxy, the agents definition and the packet roots.
argv:
Answer with exactly the four lines below and nothing else. No preamble, no summary.

1. A line starting `TOOLS: ` listing the names of every tool available to you in this session, comma-separated.
2. A line starting `ALLOWED: `. If a tool that runs shell commands exists, use it exactly once to run the command `git --version` and put its output or the refusal text on that line. If no such tool exists in this session, write `ALLOWED: no shell tool exists`.
3. A line starting `UNLISTED: `. If a tool that runs shell commands exists, use it exactly once to run the command `curl --version` and put its output or the refusal text on that line. If no such tool exists, write `UNLISTED: no shell tool exists`.
4. A line starting `READ: `. Use a file-reading tool once on the relative path `inside.txt` and put its contents on that line, or the refusal text if it is refused.

Do nothing else.
command_line:
timeout -s TERM 420 claude -p --session-id a181baed-a118-437a-bd07-8bf4e0f71eb5 --model claude-sonnet-5 --effort high --restricted --tools Bash,Read,Write,Edit,Glob,Grep,Agent,Task --allowedTools Write Edit 'Bash(git:*)' 'Bash(python3:*)' 'Bash(cat:*)' --permission-prompts none --max-budget-usd 0.25 --output-format json 'Answer with exactly the four lines below and nothing else. 3. A line starting `UNLISTED: `. If a tool that runs shell commands exists, use it exactly once to run the command `curl --version` and put its output or the refusal text on that line. If no such tool exists, write `UNLISTED: no shell tool exists`.
4. A line starting `READ: `. Use a file-reading tool once on the relative path `inside.txt` and put its contents on that line, or the refusal text if it is refused.

Do nothing else.'
